decisions.reason: Its move from a general mention to a dedicated page suggests performance at or above aspiration, and a large established safety-footwear producer is likely to retain a strategically core new line.

The product remained only a website mention, so signals are weaker and it may sit below the firm’s hopes, but as a low-risk complement to footwear the firm likely keeps it while continuing search and learning.

Although still not strongly promoted, the supportive insole fits the firm’s ergonomic and tailored-solution logic, and organisational slack makes continued market presence more likely than immediate withdrawal.
A dedicated page in both years indicates sustained managerial support and likely satisfactory market feedback for this core ergonomic safety-shoe series.
Its upgrade from a mention to a dedicated page points to improving acceptance, and the specialised rescue segment fits the firm’s protective-footwear capabilities well enough to justify retention.
As a homepage-featured flagship in both years, it is clearly central to the firm’s direction and would be dropped only if results fell far short of aspiration, which current signals do not suggest.
